CapabilityValue.description:
What a Provider declares it can do for a key (spec 05 `ProviderInstance`).

Rule: SB-6.

Finite.description:
A finite 64-bit float: NaN and the infinities are refused, so OV-15's
canonicaliser never meets one.

Rule: SB-4, OV-15.

MemoryDomainId.description:
Identifies a memory domain a sample block lives in.

Rule: SC-6 (`02-stream-contract.md`), X7.

local.description: Node-local ordinal, allocated by the owning registry.

node.description: Owning node; `0`, the local node, throughout v4.0 (X7).

ModuleId.description:
Names a Module implementation in the registry, matching
`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*$`, at most 256 bytes.

The reverse-DNS-ish namespaced form (`ezsdr.test.provider`) is what keeps two
vendors' Modules from colliding; the Kernel checks the shape, not the authority.

Rule: SB-1, MA-31.

ModuleRef.description: A Module by id and version (MA-31).

Namespace.description:
A dotted sequence of `Ident`s owned by a Vocabulary or a Module,
matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)*$`.

Rule: SB-1.

NodeId.description:
A node in the (future) multi-host deployment. `0` (the local node) is the only legal value in v4.0.

Rule: X7 (`00-overview.md`); it qualifies every id of TM-11, SC-6, SB-3 and MA-38.

anyOf.description: A signed 64-bit integer, written as an exact decimal by the canonicaliser (OV-15).

Scalar.description:
The one scalar type: a `Value`'s scalar, a constraint's and a capability's value,
and a `DataContract` attribute (SB-4, SB-5, SC-2).

Carries no tag (OV-13's carve-out): a scalar is the value an author wrote, not a
two-field object wrapping it.

Rule: SB-4, SB-6, SC-2.

description:
What an Executor declares. Admission reads `kind`, `memory_domains` and
`impl_kinds`, and `plan()` compares `module` with the binding; everything else is
opaque (MA-18, D82).

impl_kinds.description: The implementation kinds it can load (MA-39).

kind.description: The Executor kind a component's `requires.executor_kind` names (MA-39).

memory_domains.description: The memory domains it can reach (MA-39).

module.description:
The exact Module version this instance is; `plan()` refuses one that differs
from its binding (SB-22, MA-38, D82).

title: ExecutorDescriptor
